start.name: Hope W.
start.title: I’ve Learned More About Myself
start.text: I'm so glad that I took this course. I've learned more about myself than the original plan on how to deal with other people. This course has helped me to be a better person.
start.course: Diploma Course in Modern Applied Psychology (DiMAP)

start.name: Jahaziel M.
start.title: Understand Each Other Better
start.text: Started without expectations, and this course keeps on providing very insightful information that has provided great value in my life, even managing my marriage, both my wife and I have learned to communicate and understand each other better.
start.course: Diploma Course in Modern Applied Psychology (DiMAP)

start.name: Firoza M.
start.title: A Positive Change in My Life
start.text: This course challenged me all of the way and I had so many AHA moments. I am using what I have learnt and already seeing a positive change in my life. Thank you for your knowledge, passion and insight.
start.course: Mindfulness for Mental Health, Personal Growth and Inner Peace

start.name: Gladys G.
start.title: It Helped Me Look Inward
start.text: It was very engaging, informative and helped me learn a lot about myself and why I act the way I act. The live counselling sessions really helped to look inward and find a way to work on my own struggles.
start.course: Counselling Skills Practitioner Course (Beginner to Advanced)

start.name: Zehavi N.
start.title: Basic Questions About Myself
start.text: This is an excellent course! The material is presented in a very clear manner and I am brought to a place where I have to ask basic questions about myself and my relationships with others.
start.course: Diploma Course in Modern Applied Psychology (DiMAP)

start.name: Welile D.
start.title: One Course I Needed
start.text: This is one course that I needed in my life. I am just learning and becoming more clearer about some of the things that I have been overlooking for so many years.
start.course: The Complete Mental Toughness and Inner Resilience Masterclass

start.name: Kathy P.
start.title: Knowing My Core Values
start.text: I received an understanding of knowing my core values and how to apply them toward daily living and making that my purpose rather than things outside of myself.
start.course: The Clarity, Purpose and Personal Effectiveness Masterclass

start.name: Sheyla M.
start.title: Better Prepared to Make Changes
start.text: It was precisely what I needed to learn! I am better prepared to make some crucial changes in my life. Thank you very much, will share with friends and family.
start.course: The Strategic Goal Setting and Action Planning Masterclass

start.name: Rothchhinda L.
start.title: I Could See Myself in His Stories
start.text: I was dubious about this course but it actually helped me a lot, I could see myself or other people that I know in his stories and descriptions. I really found the worksheets useful and practical. I recommend this course!
start.course: Mindfulness for Mental Health, Personal Growth and Inner Peace

start.name: Gabor S.
start.title: My Life in a Different Way
start.text: The course was very insightful and gave me the confidence to pass a challenging exam I had failed before. I am looking at my life in a different way than I used to do before.
start.course: The Self-Belief, Emotional Intelligence and Assertiveness Masterclass

deeper.name: Mima L.
deeper.title: Keeping It Anchored in Real Life
deeper.text: Great, engaging course to continue gaining more knowledge and skills following the first part (beginner to advanced). Thank you for keeping it anchored in real life. Will come back for more courses.
deeper.course: Life Coaching Blueprint: The Complete Process and Practices

deeper.name: Daniel C.
deeper.title: Pursue These Topics Further
deeper.text: If you apply yourself properly to this course it is going to change your life. It is incredibly in depth and I am going to pursue these topics further at Achology.
deeper.course: Diploma Course in Modern Applied Psychology (DiMAP)

deeper.name: Suzi G.
deeper.title: From Learning to Applying Skills
deeper.text: Finding the in depth descriptions and demos really helpful. It has given me the confidence to have a go and I'm now moving from learning to applying skills.

deeper.name: Carolyn R.
deeper.title: The Next Step in My Career
deeper.text: I thoroughly enjoyed the Counselling Practitioner course, and this has equipped me to take the next step in my career. Thanks for your help, and I look forward to taking some of your other courses.
deeper.course: Counselling Skills Practitioner Course (Beginner to Advanced)

deeper.name: Nicholas M.
deeper.title: Help Myself Grow
deeper.text: I Thought this course was extremely gratifying and enlightening and I took both basic and advanced NLP course concurrently. I truly feel that I can not only help myself grow, but assist others live their best life yet.

deeper.name: Steven S.
deeper.title: Glad I Started Here
deeper.text: Glad I started my CBT education here. This course has been very helpful in determining if I would like to continue with more advanced CBT courses.
deeper.course: The CBT Toolkit: Core Principles and Real-World Applications

deeper.name: Tanita R.
deeper.title: Excited to Dig Deeper
deeper.text: I loved this course! I love how it was explained with stories and every day life examples. Really makes it easy to understand and apply to your life. Excited to dig deeper in NLP!
deeper.course: A Beginner's Guide to Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP)

deeper.name: Hellen K.
deeper.title: I Have Benefited Immensely
deeper.text: The trainer is a great teacher. I have followed him in other courses and I have benefited immensely. I look forward to this course and I trust I am in the best boat for it

deeper.name: Symi R.
deeper.title: This Is My Third Course
deeper.text: I've been "life coaching" my entire life. I decided to look into it as a professional. This is my 3rd course and I will say it was the best, most informative that I've experienced.
deeper.course: Life Coaching Blueprint: The Complete Process and Practices

deeper.name: Jzaurdan S.
deeper.title: The Depth I Needed
deeper.text: I have a general understanding of NLP because of my profession, but this course was the depth I needed to help my clients and myself.

others.name: Lee-Ami
others.title: Watching My Clients Grow
others.text: I really enjoy discovering who I am and why I behave the way I do, then look at how to grow and change. I especially enjoy watching my clients grow and develop.
others.course: Mental Health and Wellbeing Practitioner Diploma Course

others.name: TaSheba M.
others.title: A Turning Point for My Clients
others.text: Exceptional information! Practicing these teachings and exercises have been a turning point for my clients & patients. Not to mention for myself & family as well!
others.course: Mental Health and Wellbeing Practitioner Diploma Course

others.name: Hendrik V.
others.title: Relate Better to Our Clients
others.text: I can really relate to the stories and I love the way we work through the workbooks on ourselves to help us relate better to our clients. Magnificent teacher who speaks from his heart and own experience!
others.course: Life Coaching Blueprint: The Complete Process and Practices

others.name: Meeta C.
others.title: To Understand My Students
others.text: I am taking this course to understand my students, people around me better. Also learn strategies for my counselling sessions with family and friends. I find this course pretty motivating and a good learning experience until now. Thank you.
others.course: Counselling Skills Practitioner Course (Beginner to Advanced)

others.name: Sharon H.
others.title: How to Help Others
others.text: I have learnt so much about myself as well as how to help others. It has also helped me realise how much I already do know as a facilitator with our church divorce care programme which has boosted my confidence.
others.course: Counselling Skills Practitioner Course (Beginner to Advanced)

others.name: Diane B.
others.title: Help Others Do the Same Thing
others.text: This is what I've tried to do for myself, but need to understand how to help others (my students and children) to do the same thing.
others.course: The CBT Toolkit: Core Principles and Real-World Applications

others.name: Lorelei G.
others.title: More Confidence in Serving Clients
others.text: A very thorough and in depth training. I have more confidence now in serving clients to help them discover and develop a plan to reach their goals.
others.course: Life Coaching Blueprint: The Complete Process and Practices

others.name: Marisa K.
others.title: For Myself and My Future Clients
others.text: Absolutely amazing! I received a lot of applicable information and knowledge for myself and for my future clients. Thank you so much for sharing all this with me!
others.course: Mindfulness for Mental Health, Personal Growth and Inner Peace

others.name: Steve F.
others.title: So Useful and Fulfilling
others.text: That was fantastic. I never knew how much helping others could be (1) systematized, (2) improved upon and finally and most importantly (3) so useful and fulfilling. Well done.
others.course: The Skilled Helper Training Course (with Prof. Gerard Egan)

others.name: Mikal H.
others.title: To Teach Others to Teach Others
others.text: Learning about how I can get better at taking responsibility for myself, using this practice to lead others to taking responsibility for their self and most importantly learning this to teach others to teach others.
